urgent.heading: Thetha nomntu ngoku
urgent.primary_message: Ukuba ucinga ngokuzibulala, okanye ukuzenzakalisa - nceda ufikelele. Inkxaso yasimahla, eyimfihlo iyafumaneka ngoku. Akunyanzelekanga ukuba ube sengxakini ukuze ufowune.
red_flags: Iingcinga zokuphelisa ubomi bakho okanye abanye bangaphila ngcono ngaphandle kwakho
Ukuziva ndindisholo ngokupheleleyo, ungento yanto, okanye uqhawulwe kunxibelelwano lwakho
Ukunikezela ngezinto ezinentsingiselo okanye ukuthi ndlela-ntle
Ukurhoxiswa okukhulu kuye wonke umntu nayo yonke into
Ukuva amazwi, ukubona izinto abanye abangaziboniyo, okanye ukuziva ungeyonyani ngokunzulu
Ukungakwazi ukuzijonga - ungatyi, uhlambe, uphume ebhedini iintsuku
Ukuzola ngokukhawuleza emva kokudakumba ixesha elide - oku kunokuba sisilumkiso, kungekhona ukuchacha

what_is_it.heading: Ukudakumba ngokwemigaqo ecacileyo
what_is_it.lede: Ukudakumba yimeko yokwenyani yezonyango - hayi ubuthathaka, hayi isimo sengqondo esibi, hayi 'usizi nje'. Itshintsha indlela ingqondo esebenza ngayo, indlela umzimba ovakalelwa ngayo, kunye nendlela ekhangeleka ngayo yonke into. Kwaye iyanyangeka.
paragraphs: Wonke umntu uba buhlungu ngamanye amaxesha. Ukudakumba kwahlukile. Bubunzima obuhlala buhleli-imeko ephantsi eqhubekayo, ukulahlekelwa ngumdla kwizinto obuqhele ukuzonwabela, ukudinwa okungalungisekiyo ubuthongo, ukuziva ungento yanto okanye ukuphelelwa lithemba. Ihlala iiveki okanye iinyanga, hayi iiyure okanye iintsuku.

Ukudakumba kuchaphazela malunga nommi omnye kwabathandathu eMzantsi Afrika ebomini bakhe. Iqhutywa kwiintsapho. Isenokubangelwa luxinzelelo, ukugula, ukulahleka, utshintsho lwehomoni, okanye akukho nto ikhethekileyo. Ngonyango - unyango, amayeza, okanye zombini - uninzi lwabantu lubangcono kakhulu. Abaninzi bachacha ngokupheleleyo.

items.headline: 1 ku6
items.body: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika bazakufumana uxinzelelo kubomi babo bonke. Yenye yeemeko zonyango eziqhelekileyo ezikhoyo.

items.headline: Iyanyangeka
items.body: Malunga nama-80% abantu abanokudakumba babangcono kakhulu ngonyango. Abaninzi bachacha ngokupheleleyo. Uncedo luyasebenza.

items.headline: I-SADAG isimahla
items.body: 0800 567 567 ngumnxeba wasimahla wokuzibulala waseMzantsi Afrika - abacebisi abaqeqeshelwe ukumamela, ngeelwimi ezininzi, iiyure ezingama-24.

items.headline: Hayi ubuthathaka
items.body: Ukudakumba yimeko yonyango ebandakanya utshintsho kwimichiza yengqondo. Ukuxelela umntu ukuba 'aphume kuyo' kufana nokuxelela umntu onesifo seswekile ukuba enze i-insulin ibe nzima. Ayisebenzi.

pull_quote.text: Ukuzabalazela uncedo akubobuthathaka. Yenye yezona zinto zikhaliphileyo nezinzima anokuzenza umntu odandathekileyo. Ukuba ucinga ngako - yenza umnxeba. Umntu kwelinye icala ulungile.

signs.heading: Kukhangeleka njani ukudakumba
signs.lede: Ukudakumba kubonakala ngokwahlukileyo kubantu abahlukeneyo. Ezinye iimpawu zeemvakalelo, ezinye ngokwasemzimbeni, ezinye zezentlalo. Iiveki ezimbini zezi mpawu uninzi lwemini ngumda wokuthatha nzulu.

items.title: Ngokweemvakalelo
items.description: Usizi oluzingisileyo okanye ukungento yanto, ukungabi nathemba, ukuziva ungento yanto okanye unetyala, ukucaphuka okanye umsindo (usoloko uphoswa ngamadoda), ukuphelelwa ngumdla kwizinto obukade uzinandipha.

items.title: Ngokwasemzimbeni
items.description: Ukudinwa ukuba ubuthongo abuyi kulungisa, utshintsho kumdla wokutya (udla ngokutya ngaphantsi okanye ngaphezulu kunesiqhelo), iintlungu neentlungu, ukunyakaza okucothayo okanye intetho, ukuphazamiseka kokulala — nokuba kuninzi kakhulu okanye ukungakwazi ukulala.

items.title: Ezentlalo kunye nengqondo
items.description: Ukurhoxa kubahlobo kunye nosapho, uzama ukwenza izigqibo okanye ukuzikisa ingqondo, iingcinga ezizingisileyo zokuzenzakalisa okanye ukufa. Ezi ngcinga ziqhelekile kuxinzelelo - kunye nesizathu sokufikelela kuncedo, ungabahluli ngaphezulu.

items.myth: Ukudakumba bubuthathaka nje - kufuneka ukwazi ukuzitsala kunye.
items.fact: Ukudakumba yimeko yokwenyani yonyango ebandakanya utshintsho kwimichiza yengqondo. Ukuxelela umntu odandathekileyo ukuba 'ahlukane nalo' kufana nokuxelela umntu onesifo seswekile ukuba enze i-insulin ibe nzima. Ayisebenzi kwaye iyabahlazisa.

items.myth: Amachiza okuthomalalisa ayakhobokisa kwaye atshintshe umntu onguye.
items.fact: Ii-antidepressants zanamhlanje azikhoboki - nangona kufuneka zicocwe kancinci xa ziyeka. Ababutshintshi ubuntu bakho. Baphakamisa inkungu ukuze ube nguwe kwakhona.

Ukudakumba kwenzeka kuyo yonke indawo eMhlabeni, kuzo zonke iinkcubeko, ngamaxabiso afanayo. Indlela ezibonisa ngayo inokwahluka (iimpawu zomzimba ezingakumbi kwezinye iinkcubeko), kodwa imeko esisiseko yendalo yonke - kwaye iyanyangeka.

items.myth: Ukuthetha ngokuzibulala kwenza ukuba kwenzeke ngakumbi.
items.fact: Okuchaseneyo kuyinyaniso. Ukubuza 'ingaba uneengcinga zokuzibulala' kubonisa inkathalo kwaye kudala indawo yokufumana uncedo. Ukuthula nokuphepha zizinto ezenza izinto zibe mandundu.

items.title: Ukuba usengxakini — tsalela i-SADAG ngoku
items.description: 0800 567 567 simahla kuyo nayiphi na ifowuni, iiyure ezingama-24. Abacebisi baqeqeshelwa ukumamela. Akunyanzelekanga ukuba ube 'sengxakini ngokwaneleyo' - vele uqhubeke.

items.title: Ukuba unako - xelela umntu omnye
items.description: Umhlobo, ilungu losapho, inkokeli yenkolo, umphathi. Ukuyithetha ngokuvakalayo kanye kophula eyona nto imbi yokuba wedwa. Akunyanzelekanga ukuba uyicacise ngokugqibeleleyo.

items.title: Yiya ekliniki uyokwenza uvavanyo
items.description: Iiklinikhi zikarhulumente zibonelela ngovavanyo kunye nonyango lwasimahla lwempilo yengqondo. Cela 'umongikazi wezempilo yengqondo' okanye ugqirha. Iyeza lokuthomalalisa uxinezeleko lisimahla ezikliniki ukuba liyafuneka.

items.title: Ukuba uyakwazi ukulawula izinto zemihla ngemihla
items.description: Fumana ukukhanya kwelanga kusasa, hamba ukuba unako, utye ukutya okuncinci okuqhelekileyo nangaphandle kokutya, ulale ngendlela eqhelekileyo. Akukho nanye kwezi enyanga ukudakumba - kodwa inceda unyango lusebenze ngcono.

items.title: Ukuba umntu omthandayo une depression
items.description: Mamela ngaphandle kokuzama ukulungisa. Sukuthi 'chwayita' okanye 'abanye banengxaki ngakumbi'. Yithi 'Ndilapha, ndiyakubona, yintoni enokunceda'. Bakhuthaze ukuba babize i-SADAG kunye.

get_help.heading: Ngubani ozokutsalela umnxeba ngoku
get_help.lede: UMzantsi Afrika unenkxaso yasimahla, eyimfihlo yempilo yengqondo efumaneka iiyure ezingama-24 ngosuku. Awudingi ncedo lwezonyango, isazisi, okanye ukuthunyelwa. Ifowuni nje.
